skills.trigger: When evaluating a mass located at the lung base or costophrenic angle on a chest X-ray to determine if it represents a primary breast/chest wall lesion or a pulmonary metastasis.
steps: Confirm the mass is situated within the lower lung zone and overlaps with pulmonary parenchyma rather than projecting exclusively over the soft tissues of the breast or chest wall.
Assess the mass margins; irregular or ill-defined borders favor a malignant pulmonary process (metastasis) over a benign chest wall lesion.
Integrate the anatomical location (intrapulmonary vs. extrapulmonary) with clinical history to prioritize lung-to-breast/chest wall metastasis when the lesion appears intrinsic to the lung field.
